options: Some twentieth-century economists gave Smith's metaphor of the invisible hand a significance it does not have in Smith's work, but it is nevertheless a useful model of how individuals produce aggregate benefits by pursuing their own economic interests. 8% 选择

questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?
options: while Valdez's presence in Instant Mural represents the social constraints placed on women at the time, Sandoval's presence represents Chicano muralists' frustration at their lack of recognition by the art establishment. 15% 选择
Instant Mural is best understood not as a critique of the social constraints placed on women but rather as a critique of sociohistorical muralists' depictions of Chicano culture. 20% 选择
the main subject of Instant Mural is female Chicano artists' experience of being doubly constrained by gender-role expectations and the marginalization of certain types of art. 10% 选择
Instant Mural is a reflection on the constraining aesthetic expectations placed on Chicano artists in general rather than on the social constraints placed on women specifically. 正确选项 55% 选择
